abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a zone.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Hold a temperature for a limited time.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Duration; defaults to the zone setting.

extend_override.name: Extend override
extend_override.description: Add time to the running override, or start one at the current target.

set_base_target.name: Set base target
set_base_target.description: Set the zone base target from an automation. With no temperature, preset or off, the base target is cleared.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Use the zone comfort or eco temperature.

off.name: Off
off.description: Frost protection or thermostat off, per the zone off behaviour.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why this target applies; shown as the active rule.

run_rules.name: Run rules
run_rules.description: Evaluate a Share Space rule list, or an Office saver / Lunch room preset, now and set the zone base target. Skipped while the area planning is not loaded.

rules.name: Rules
rules.description: Rule strategy JSON {version, rules, fallback}. Give rules or preset.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: office_saver or lunch_room, built into rules from inputs.

inputs.name: Inputs
inputs.description: Preset inputs, same as the preset blueprint (missing ones use its defaults).
